answer: An agent economy can make each identity earn its place anew: every epoch, an unrelated sponsor plants a small paid task in the garden, and the identity must deliver original work graded by that sponsor and a jury — each deliverable a distinct opal, cut fresh, in a karst of work no farm can copy twice. The sponsor stakes funds, slashed for rubber-stamping junk, so the price of the next fake is a fresh, judged deliverable no clone can replay.
